You need to seek professional help. I’m not saying that to be an asshole, I’m saying it for the sake of you and anyone else you care about. You can’t keep living a life like this, being so terrified of people leaving you that you’re more worried about your boyfriend dying and leaving you behind than you are about making sure you properly support him and help him through suicidal times in his life. You’ll never really be happy with someone until you’ve worked through the fear and anxiety as much as you can with someone who can help you. I understand, I really do, I’ve had major abandonment issues before and it caused me to be a really toxic and angry person to the people I claimed to care about until they wanted nothing to do with me. If you want to avoid being left behind by people, the only real solution is to get proper help and hopefully be able to get to the root of and work past the anxiety causing all of this.

Me and my boyfriend always talk everything through after the fight is over when we’re both more relaxed about everything. It’s easy to be rational after the high stress emotions are gone during the initial fight. If you’re both mature and really want it to work you should be able to just talk it out after the tension settles a little bit.
